docs.title: 本站​介紹
docs.text: ​一個​家​醫科​醫師​整理​的​一些​筆記​，​希望​對​大家​有​幫助​。

docs.title: 作者​介紹
docs.text: ​您好​，​我​是​陳​漎​銨​。​是​家​醫科​專科​醫師​，​也​是​安寧緩​和​專科​醫師​。

docs.title: Etiology and pathogenesis
docs.text:
• Pathogens (1)
    • ​最常見​為​細菌​感染​：PsA、S.A
    • fungus ​也​有​可能​ (otomycosis)：aspergillus、candia
    • virus：HSV、VZV

docs.title: Epidemiology and risk factors
docs.text:
• Epidemiology (1)
    • incidence 10%，increased in summer，often after trauma or swimming
  • Risk factors (1)
    • Disease：eczema、poor removal of ear wax、narrow auditory canal
    • Others：swimmer、trauma、hearing aid
    • Complicated AOE risk factors
      • DM、immunocompromise
      • cranial radiotherapy or radiation

docs.title: Clinical presentation
docs.text:
• Symptoms (1)
    • otalgia、itching、fullness (rapid onset < 48 hrs)
    • Other symptoms：hearing loss、jaw pain、vertigo
  • Signs (1)
    • pinna tenderness、ear canal edema or erythema、otorrhea、tympanic membrane erythema
    • regional LAD、cellulitis
  • Complication (1)
    • middle ear disease、osteitis、abscess
    • Red flag：headache or pain out of proportion、fever、granulation tissue at bony cartilage junction → ​可能​是​ necrotizing infection → ​可能​有​生命​危險​，​要​去​急診​

docs.title: Diagnosis and workup
docs.text:
• Diagnosis：​藉由​ ​臨床​症狀​ ​診斷​ (2)
    • rapid onset (<48 hrs) + ear canal inflammation symptoms and signs
  • Workup (2)
    • otoscopy (+ pneumatic otoscopy)
    • ear canal culture
    • ​若懷疑​ malignant otitis externa，​要​考慮​做​ image ​如​ CT ​等​
    • ​若有​ granulation tissue ​可​考慮​ biopsy

docs.title: Management, prognosis and follow up
docs.text:
• ​生活型​態調整​：​保持​耳道​清潔​，​移除​異物​和​耳垢​。keep ear dry for 7D (3)
  • ​藥物​
    • Tarivid 10gtt QD-BID for 7-14 day
    • Mycomb ear drop 2-3gtt TID-QID 7D
      • ​耳滴劑​使用​方式​：​患耳朝​上​，​點藥水​，tragal massage + ​朝上​ 5 mins (1)
    • ​其他​可​考慮​口服​止痛​藥物​ (3)
  • Prognosis
    • ​症狀​痊​癒​需​2​周​，​但​48-72​小時​應​好轉​。(3)
  • Follow up
    • if no improvement within 3 days → refer to ENT

docs.title: Etiology and pathogenesis
docs.text: • ​耳蝸​功能​喪失​ + ​腦部​對​聲音​處理​的​功能​衰退​ (2)

docs.title: Epidemiology and risk factors
docs.text:
• 60 ​歲​以上​較常見​。60 ​歲​以上​， ​每年​聽力​下降​ 1 ​分貝​ (2)
  • Risk factors
    • ​個​人​特質​：​家族史​、​男性​ (2)
    • ​過去​病史​：DM、atherosclerosis、CVA、renal disease、immunosuppression (2)
    • ​物質​暴露​：ototoxic drug、smoking (2)

docs.title: Diagnosis and workup
docs.text:
• Diagnosis：​要​透過​ pure tone audiometry ​來​確定​聽力​喪失​的​狀況​ (2)
    • WHO ​藉由​ 500、1000、2000、4000 Hz ​四個​頻率​來​決定​ hearing loss ​的​嚴重​程度​ (2)
  • Workup
    • PE
      • ​看​外耳道​有​無​阻塞​ (2)
      • ​可用​ whispered test、finger rub test ​篩檢​ (2)
      • ​用​ Weber test、Rinne test ​來​分辨​ conductive or sensorineural hearing loss (2)
      • pure tone audiometry (2)
        • ​氣導​ O ​右耳​ X ​左耳​；​骨導​ [ ​右耳​ ] ​左耳​

docs.title: Management、prognosis and follow up
docs.text:
• ​無特別​可以​減緩​聽力​退化​的​藥物​ (2)
  • ​控制​好共病​如​ DM、HTN (2)
  • ​可​考慮​助​聽器​、cochlear implantation (2)
  • Prescubysis related tinnitus
    • Euclidan 2wk -> dogmatyl 2wk -> giko (3)
    • ​可​搭配​ rivotril 0.5mg HS or xanax 1# HS (3)
  • Prognosis：
    • ​隨著​年紀​增加​而​逐漸​退化​ (2)
